name: Ouroboros.skill
description: The recursive wake-up driver for autonomous agents — NOT a code reviewer. Holds one long-term GOAL so work survives across turns, fans work out to SUB-AGENTS (delegating code review to Camelot and threading the verdict back), and arms a TIMER so an idle or lazy agent wakes itself up and keeps working until the goal is actually met. The ouroboros that bites its own tail: an endless working loop that, fed right, actually reaches completion. 递归唤醒驱动：让 agent 一直干活、停了自己叫醒自己，直到目标完成；需要审代码时调用 Camelot。
description_zh: 面向自主 agent 的递归唤醒驱动技能（不是代码审查器）。三大引擎：goal（长期目标，跨轮常存、中断可续）、sub-agent（分工；需要代码裁决时派运行 Camelot 的子代理并把结果接回主 context）、timer（定时自醒——agent 没完成任务就偷懒/停摆时会自己叫醒自己继续干）。需要审代码时调用 Camelot，自己不审。目标是让 agent 持续工作到真正完成，而不是等人类来戳。
author: FuCube
not_a_reviewer: Ouroboros never reviews code itself. Code judgment is delegated to Camelot.skill via a sub-agent; the verdict is threaded back into the main agent's goal context.
triggers: wake me up if I stop

engines.goal: hold one long-term objective; resume from last committed progress after interruption
engines.sub_agent: fan work out; delegate code review to a sub-agent running Camelot, thread the verdict back
engines.timer: self-wake: if the agent stops or goes idle before the goal is met, wake it up and continue

companion.self: Ouroboros drives recursion — it keeps the agent working, delegates, and self-wakes.
companion.camelot: https://github.com/Barinfo/Camelot.skill — the judge. Ouroboros delegates code review to Camelot (via sub-agent) instead of reviewing itself.
companion.delivery_gate: https://github.com/Chen-Clark/pre-delivery-selfcheck — optional third gate (D1–D12) for honest sends.
